verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Braintrust has API keys and permission groups scoped to organizations, projects and objects. Nothing ties those permissions to issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials (for example service accounts or restricted keys) for an agent. Permission groups are an adjacent access-control feature, not the credential-scoping capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
